title: 朝阳一中2026——2027学年度第一学期期中质量检测 七年级英语试卷

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
| Name | Age(年龄) | Phone number | thing |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Jane Brown | 11 | 534-6887 | A black pen |
| Mike Smith | 12 | 682-3169 | A purple ruler |
| Mary Green | 13 | 658-7466 | A yellow jacket |
| Gina Miller | 14 | 592-2347 | A map of China |

questions.prompt: 21. ______ is Jane's last name.
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据表格第一行“Jane Brown”，英文名中姓在后，所以Jane的姓是Brown。故选 'Brown'。
细节理解题。根据表格第二行“Mike Smith | 12”，可知Mike 12岁。故选 '12'。

questions.prompt: 23. The jacket is ______.
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据表格第三行“Mary Green ... A yellow jacket”，可知夹克是Mary的。故选 'Mary's'。

questions.prompt: 24. Which of the following is RIGHT?
options: The map of China is not Gina's.
Mary and Gina are of the same age.
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据表格第二行，Mike的电话号码是682-3169。故选 'Mike's telephone number is 682-3169.'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
**Mom:** Good evening (晚上) Andy
**Andy:** Good morning, Mom. I'm in Beijing.
**Mom:** Haha, which class are you in?
**Andy:** I'm in Class 2, Grade 7.
**Mom:** Who is your best friend?
**Andy:** My best friend is Zhang Yixuan. She is in Class 3, Grade 8.
**Mom:** Does she like running?
**Andy:** Yes she does. She also likes singing and drawing.
**Mom:** Are you happy now?
**Andy:** Yes I am.
**Mom:** See you.
**Andy:** See you.

questions.prompt: 25. What time of day is it in Beijing now?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据Andy说“Good morning, Mom. I'm in Beijing.”可知，北京现在是早上。故选 'In the morning.'。

questions.prompt: 26. Which class is Andy in?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据Andy说“I'm in Class 2, Grade 7.”可知，他在七年级二班。故选 'Class 2, Grade 7.'。

questions.prompt: 27. How does Andy feel(觉得)?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。当妈妈问“Are you happy now?”时，Andy回答“Yes I am.”，说明他很开心。故选 'Happy.'。

questions.prompt: 28. Which of the following is NOT mentioned(提及) as Zhang Yixuan's hobby?
questions.translation: 下列哪项没有被提及为张艺轩的爱好？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。对话中提到她喜欢running、singing和drawing，没有提到reading。故选 'Reading.'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage: Hi, I'm Brian. This is the photo of my family. My grandfather is with glasses. He has little hair. The one standing next to him is my uncle. He is wearing a cap. My grandmother has gray hair. She is a kind woman. She is holding my younger brother. He has short curly hair. The woman standing behind me is my mom. She has straight brown hair. There is a little girl sitting on the table. Her name is Cathy. She is my sister. She is wearing a green T-shirt and a pair of green socks. It's her favorite color. Which one is my father? Well, he is wearing glasses, too. He is in brown shorts and brown shoes. His name is Sam. Now do you know where he is?

questions.prompt: 29. How many people are there in the passage (文章)?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。文中提到Brian、grandfather、uncle、grandmother、younger brother、mom、sister Cathy、father Sam，共8个人。故选 'Eight.'。

questions.prompt: 30. What is Cathy's favorite color?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文中“She is wearing a green T-shirt and a pair of green socks. It's her favorite color.”可知，她最喜欢的颜色是绿色。故选 'Green.'。

questions.prompt: 31. Who is wearing glasses?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据“My grandfather is with glasses.”和“Which one is my father? Well, he is wearing glasses, too.”可知，Brian的爷爷和爸爸都戴着眼镜。故选 'Brian's grandpa and father.'。

questions.prompt: 32. What is the main (主要的) idea of the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨是什么？
questions.explanation: 主旨大意题。文章开头点明“This is the photo of my family.”，通篇介绍全家福中的家人。故选 'Brian's family photo.'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My name is Tony, and this is my classroom. I like it very much.
My classroom is bright and clean. On the back wall you can see a map. It's a map of China. Some paintings are beside the map. And there is a new football in our classroom, but you can't see it. It's under the teacher's desk. Many boys in our class like playing football after class. I often play it with my classmates and I play it very well.
At school, we always wear school clothes. Our teachers are very friendly. We have four lessons in the morning and three classes in the afternoon. We have lunch at school. After class we like playing games. We can also join different kinds of clubs.
I'm on duty this morning. I help my teacher prepare (准备) things. It's time for class. I tell my teacher everyone is here and we are all ready for the class.

questions.prompt: 33. Where is the map?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段“On the back wall you can see a map.”可知，地图在后墙上。故选 'On the back wall.'。

questions.prompt: 34. How many classes does Tony have a day?
questions.explanation: 数字计算题。根据第三段“We have four lessons in the morning and three classes in the afternoon.”可知，上午4节、下午3节，共7节课。故选 'Seven.'。

questions.prompt: 35. What do boys like doing after class?
questions.translation: 男生们下课后喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段“Many boys in our class like playing football after class.”可知，男生们喜欢踢足球。故选 'Playing football.'。

questions.prompt: 36. In which part of the newspaper can we read the passage?
questions.translation: 我们可以在报纸的哪个版块读到这篇文章？
questions.explanation: 推理判断题。文章主要介绍了Tony的教室和学校生活，因此最可能出现在“生活与学校”版块。故选 'Life and school.'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 第二节 (阅读还原)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框内所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage: Hi, everyone! This is my room. Can you see the photo on the wall? It's my family photo. I have a big family. There are six people in my family. They are my father, my mother, my brother, my grandpa, my grandma and me. My grandparents are in the middle of the photo. [1] They like walking after supper. My father is a teacher. He has a car. [2] My mother is a doctor. She works in a hospital. She has a bike. She often rides her bike to work. [3] She has a pet dog. We love the dog. My brother is four years old. He has some nice toys. He often plays with his toys at home. I am a middle school student. I am thirteen years old. [4] You can see many trees near the big playground. My teachers are nice to me. I like English best. I like my school.
wordbank: He goes to work on foot.
My school is big and clean.

questions.explanation: 前句提到祖父母在照片中间，主语是复数My grandparents，此处介绍他们的职业“They are workers.”最合适。故选 'They are workers.'。
前句提到“He has a car.”（他有一辆小汽车），因此他开车去上班。故选 'He drives to work.'。
后句提到“She has a pet dog.”（她有一只宠物狗），说明她喜欢动物。故选 'She likes animals.'。
后句接着描述大操场旁边的树和友好的老师，因此此处引出对学校的介绍。故选 'My school is big and clean.'。

sections.title: 二、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，理解其大意，从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hi, I'm Anna. Today is Sunday. My family and I go to my uncle's farm. It's a big [1] beautiful place with many kinds of plants and animals.
Look! There [2] some apple trees in the yard. Under the trees, my cousin Lily is playing with her rabbit. The rabbit is white and small—it [3] eating carrots from the farm. Near the trees, there is [4] lake. Some [5] are swimming in it. My uncle says those are [6].
My dad and uncle are talking behind the big house. What about my mom? She is [7] the kitchen with my aunt. They are washing tomatoes and potatoes for lunch. I want to help them, but Lily asks me to count the baby chickens. There are twelve—they are so [8]. We all have fun [9] the farm. I would like [10] here again next Sunday.

questions.translation: 41. 它是一个又大又漂亮的地方。
questions.explanation: big和beautiful是并列形容词，用and连接表示“又大又漂亮”。故选 'and'。
there be句型遵循就近原则，some apple trees为复数，be动词用are。故选 'are'。

questions.translation: 43. 它喜欢吃农场里的胡萝卜。
questions.explanation: 主语it为第三人称单数，且全文为一般现在时，谓语动词用likes。故选 'likes'。
此处泛指“一个湖”，lake以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a。故选 'a'。
some后接可数名词复数，goose的复数形式是不规则变化geese。故选 'geese'。

questions.translation: 46. 我叔叔说那些鹅是他的。
questions.explanation: 此处表示“他的（鹅）”，后面没有名词，用名词性物主代词his。故选 'his'。
in the kitchen表示“在厨房里”。故选 'in'。

questions.translation: 48. 有十二只小鸡——它们太可爱了。
questions.explanation: 形容小鸡（baby chickens）应用cute（可爱的）。故选 'cute'。

questions.translation: 49. 我们在农场上都玩得很开心。
questions.explanation: on the farm是固定搭配，意为“在农场上”。故选 'on'。

questions.translation: 50. 我下周日还想再来这里。
questions.explanation: would like to do sth.是固定搭配，意为“想要做某事”。故选 'to come'。

sections.title: 三、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给词的正确形式填空，使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage:
Hi Flora,
Thanks for your email. To answer [1] (you) question, my new school is great! It's very beautiful. There are [2] (much) modern buildings. There's a large sports field next to the school hall. All the students go there and do exercises together in [3] morning. It's [4] (amaze). Every Monday we raise the flag there. It's a special way [5] (start) the week.
The classroom building is behind the sports field. We spend most of the time [6] our classroom. It's big and clean. Every week, we [7] (change) seats. This week I sit next to my [8] (well) friend, Han Lin.
The dining hall is across from the sports field. It's my favourite place [9] there are many [10] (kind) of food. I love the Chinese food there. My favourite food is jiaozi. It's delicious! How about your school?
Yours,
Peter

questions.translation: 51. 为了回答你的问题，我的新学校棒极了！
questions.explanation: 修饰名词question应用形容词性物主代词your。故选 'your'。

questions.translation: 52. 这里有许多现代化的建筑。
questions.explanation: buildings为可数名词复数，应用many修饰“许多”。故选 'many'。

questions.translation: 53. 所有的学生早上都去那里一起做早操。
questions.explanation: in the morning是固定搭配，意为“在早上”。故选 'the'。
此处作表语修饰物（it指代前面做早操这件事），应用以-ing结尾的形容词amazing（令人惊叹的）。故选 'amazing'。

questions.translation: 55. 这是开启一周的一种特别方式。
questions.explanation: a way to do sth.表示“做某事的方式”，此处用动词不定式to start作后置定语。故选 'to start'。

questions.translation: 56. 我们大部分时间都在教室里度过。
questions.explanation: 在教室里用介词in，in our classroom。故选 'in'。
Every week表示经常性动作，主语we为复数，用动词原形change。故选 'change'。

questions.translation: 58. 这周我坐在我最好的朋友韩林旁边。
questions.explanation: 此处表示“最好的朋友”，用形容词最高级best（my best friend）。故选 'best'。

questions.translation: 59. 这是我最喜欢的地方，因为那里有很多种食物。
questions.explanation: 前后句为因果关系，后句解释原因，用because连接。故选 'because'。

questions.translation: 60. 因为那里有很多种食物。
questions.explanation: many后接可数名词复数，many kinds of表示“许多种类的”。故选 'kinds'。

sections.title: 四、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，然后根据内容回答问题。
sections.passage: My name is Zhang Yue. I'm a Chinese girl. I have two good friends, Linda and Zhang Wei. We are in the same school and we often play together (一起). Linda is fourteen years old, and she is from England. There are four people in her family. They are all in Chaoyang now. Zhang Wei is my cousin. He is thirteen years old now, the same as me. Zhang Wei and I are in the same class. After school, we three like playing sports very much. We all like playing football. But Zhang Wei's favourite sport is table tennis. Look! There is a table tennis ball in his hand now!

questions.prompt: 61. Where is Linda from?
questions.explanation: 根据文中“Linda is fourteen years old, and she is from England.”可知，Linda来自英国。故选 'England.'。

questions.prompt: 62. How old is Zhang Yue now?
questions.explanation: 根据文中“He is thirteen years old now, the same as me.”可知，张悦也是13岁。故选 'Thirteen.'。

questions.prompt: 63. What is Zhang Wei's favourite sport?
questions.translation: 张伟最喜欢的运动是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“But Zhang Wei's favourite sport is table tennis.”可知，张伟最喜欢的运动是乒乓球。故选 'Table tennis.'。

questions.prompt: 64. Do you want to make friends with Zhang Yue? Why or Why not? (No less than 20 words)
options: Yes, I do. Because she is friendly and likes playing sports. I also like playing football, so we can play together after school.
No, I don't. I don't like making any new friends at school.
Yes, I do. She has a lot of money.
No, I don't. She is too old for me.
questions.translation: 你想和张悦交朋友吗？为什么或为什么不？（不少于20词）
questions.explanation: 开放性问题，需表明态度并说明合理原因且不少于20词。第一项积极合理且字数达标。故选 'Yes, I do. Because she is friendly and likes playing sports. I also like playing football, so we can play together after school.'。
